conversation.text: How much is the maintenance plan?

According to the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), the Comfort Club Standard plan is $189 per year per system, or $16.99 per month, and each additional system at the same address is $99 per year.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Monthly plans require a 12-month minimum commitment.

Comfort Club members get two seasonal tune-ups per year, priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on service calls, 15% off repairs, no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.
Plus members also get an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
Both Standard and Plus members get $500 off any full system replacement.
I thought it was $149?
The 2026 fee schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf) lists the Comfort Club annual membership at $189 for one system, not $149, and Comfort Club Plus at $269.
The monthly Comfort Club rate is $16.99, and Plus is not offered monthly.

The only $149 I see is the after-hours emergency dispatch fee for non-members, which the 2026 Repair Price Book (pricing/repair_price_book_2026.csv) and the customer FAQ (faq/customer_faq.md) both list and which is waived for Comfort Club members.
I don't have any document showing a $149 membership price.
Hm. Okay.
Understood.

One thing that may explain the $149 you remember: the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md) says existing members are locked at their enrollment price until their next renewal date, when the current price applies.
So if you enrolled at a different price before, that could differ from today's $189 rate, though the documents I have don't show what any earlier price was.
For reference, the current Standard plan is $189 per year per system or $16.99 per month, and Plus is $269 per year per system, per the same document.
